statuses.implemented: Software for the requirement is complete; only acceptance in other evidence classes remains.
statuses.partial: Some software exists and named software gaps remain.
statuses.deferred: Out of the MVP by recorded policy.
statuses.blocked: Cannot progress without an external decision, resource or artifact.

note: Status is software state, not acceptance. Evidence lists source and test paths that implement or check the requirement; they are not passing results. Each gate names the next evidence class required. Refreshed 2026-10-11 at main 2560eead against upstream pin 13c9857598, with every entry re-read. At that pin there are source and browser test results, developer APK builds without the resident runtime (not distributable) and one partial emulator campaign on those builds (docs/verification.md, Emulator results at 2961bd9e, called round 8 below). Where an entry cites an emulator result it is that campaign or the round 7 campaign at the earlier pin 40dbe96bd1 (Emulator results at 6dcdde34), named as such. Both are class E on developer APKs and neither is evidence for a distributable build or a device. No hosted emulator job has been dispatched and no device result exists (docs/mvp-current-status.md, Current qualification evidence). Round 10 integration adds accessibility, native robustness, approval-notice recovery and strict-build changes after this evidence snapshot. References below to current source failures describe the recorded round 8 APKs; they are not results for the combined source. See the round 10 sections in docs/verification.md. October 11 full-product scope amendment: AP-08 and AP-13 are now included by the user; their entries below record remaining implementation and provider dependencies, not acceptance.

requirements.title: Distinct branded home, app grid and assistant entry; independent package and storage identity
requirements.gate: E: LauncherLibrary, which has never run, and the HOME-role phase (SettingsRoles, LauncherHome) on a distributable launcher APK; then D on the selected phone
requirements.remaining: The All-apps drawer, search and landscape Home exist with browser tests against a stubbed bridge. On an emulator the HOME-role phase passed on developer APKs at the current pin (round 8: SettingsRoles and LauncherHome 3 of 3 on the final APKs with the original HOME holder read back; class E), and the launcher flavor keeps one live MainActivity when the role is granted. Favorites and order, exact component and profile identity and refresh on package change are implemented in source with Node and stubbed-bridge browser tests; LauncherLibraryInstrumentedTest has never run (MVP-53). No distributable build, image or phone has run any of it.

requirements.title: Standalone and HOME APKs from one source; offline shell; stock settings and recovery accessible
requirements.gate: B: four distribution APKs build at the current pin and pass scripts/verify-apks.mjs; then E: install both modes, open apps and return HOME repeatedly
requirements.remaining: No distribution APK build exists at the current pin (13c9857598): the strict build stops at the reviewed embedding host libraries, which are not in Git and which a person must supply, and it needs qualified speech assets that do not exist (MVP-39, MVP-23). Developer APKs without the resident runtime were built there (hosted Android foundation runs 38118499272 at c0b19147 and 38131665152 at f87850fa, and development machines); none is distributable. Both flavors of a developer build were installed on an emulator in round 8 and the default classes passed except BrowserFlow, which fails on its live-search method (class E). The Welcome dialog's local-apps entry is covered by a stubbed-bridge browser test; nothing has run on a device.

requirements.title: Existing Eliza sign-in and pairing with an approved Alpha routing adapter and owner-scoped credentials
requirements.gate: R and D: real-device wrong-owner and wrong-origin, expired and reused token, and callback tests against the managed endpoint (A-02)
requirements.remaining: Production Android pairing is retired by design. Cloud self-revocation on sign-out and the native pairing-route guard have synthetic and JVM coverage only: no live Eliza Cloud revocation and no device run, and the instrumented class for the installed transport (ConnectionInstrumentedTest) runs only in the hosted recovery-ui job, which has never been dispatched. The web build cannot sign in to or revoke Eliza Cloud.

requirements.title: Android-resident agent execution with hosted Qwen inference on Cerebras, honest offline state and reconnect/history restoration
requirements.gate: E then D: resident process restart and reconnect without duplicate messages or writes; no inference-available claim without provider health evidence
requirements.remaining: Emulator and device acceptance of restart, reconnect, Stop and history restoration; the resident process-kill classes run only in the hosted CI lane, which has never been dispatched, and no APK that packages the resident runtime has been built. Cloud agents have no cancel route or older-page history cursor, and the read after Stop matches by text and time because upstream history rows do not expose the client message ID.

requirements.title: Pill, input, overlay and full assistant modes with keyboard and navigation continuity
requirements.gate: E: soft-keyboard resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction on an installed APK; then D
requirements.remaining: Draft retention through every pre-dispatch failure is implemented with browser source evidence only (test/browser/chat-continuity.spec.ts). Emulator and device acceptance of resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction remain: Shell, which has a soft-keyboard layout check, passed on both flavors of the developer APKs in round 8 (class E), and Assistant and Flow have no recorded run. Attaching the assistant surface to a running resident without restarting it is implemented in source with JVM and renderer contract tests; AssistantResidentReuseInstrumentedTest has never run (MVP-16).

requirements.title: Voice entry and cancellation with explicit microphone state and typing fallback
requirements.gate: Owner: remaining voice route/fallback policy (MVP-01) and whether on-device speech is still required (A-24); then R: Cloud speech with a signed-in account, and D: physical audio, interruption and latency (A-10)
requirements.remaining: Flag-off builds use Eliza Cloud speech (P-07); no real Cloud transcription has been exercised. The committed on-device speech qualification is failed on arm64-v8a and x86_64 execution is unverified; a candidate runtime passed the unchanged test on an arm64 emulator at an earlier pin and is not admitted, the hosted x86_64 job has never been dispatched, and whether on-device speech is still required is pending (A-24). The October 12 update to P-01 approves automatic sending after explicitly starting an ongoing chat voice session. Notes retains review/save; route/fallback decisions remain MVP-01. The denied- and revoked-microphone campaigns passed on both flavors in the round 7 emulator run at the earlier pin (class E, developer-override APKs) and were not repeated at the current pin.

requirements.title: Daily overview with real agenda, attention items and briefs
requirements.gate: R: real provider agenda and digests with loading, empty, stale and error states; then D
requirements.remaining: Agenda comes from on-device calendars only, and schedules are digest-only. A missed occurrence is recorded once and never replaces the last brief. The Home cards name their source and when it was read, and the latest retained brief has its own card, with synthetic provider data only. Browser tests run from a digest result to that card with a stubbed agent and Android bridge; no real scheduled digest, native delivery or device calendar read is behind it (MVP-19).

requirements.title: Phone, messages and contacts
requirements.gate: Implement FP-01–FP-03, then E native roles/provider flows and D carrier delivery, audio and return-to-HOME
requirements.remaining: Scope included by the user on October 11. Prototype references remain, but production entries and actions are disabled; restore Contacts provider integration and implement real Phone/SMS roles, lifecycle, reviewed recipients and recovery.

requirements.title: Inbox and calendar
requirements.gate: R: real Google OAuth grant, managed Cloud Gmail routes and a real mailbox; then D: a real synced calendar account on a phone
requirements.remaining: Gmail OAuth code exchange returns 401 (docs/cloud-production-validation.md), so no real mailbox has been used. Calendar shows only on-device calendars. On an emulator at the current pin the Calendar campaign passed on both flavors of the developer APKs (round 8, class E, fixture rows in the emulator's CalendarProvider): CalendarCrud, both CalendarAgentCrud methods, CalendarAvailability, CalendarTruncation, CalendarRange and CalendarFlow; InboxOperationJournal, MailAttachment and the inbox restart campaign passed there too. Use in email is implemented in source with synthetic agent and provider tests only (MVP-14). No real account, synced calendar or device has run any of it (MVP-12).

requirements.title: Browser, camera, photos, maps, notes and files
requirements.gate: E: the reading and page-question classes on a WebView with isolated-world injection, and BrowserFlow's live-search method; Owner: a production Maps provider (A-23); then R and D
requirements.remaining: No flag-off build has a Maps provider, so no route can be produced for a production user (A-23). Native Camera has image selection into scan review and the multi-page scan builder; device behaviour is unverified. On an emulator at the current pin (round 8, developer APKs, class E) BrowserSignins, BrowserContinuity, PasswordBrowserFill, CameraScan and FilesTree passed on both flavors; BrowserFlow fails on its live-search method, and the reading and page-question classes cannot run on the available WebView, which has no isolated-world injection (the hosted suite for them has never been dispatched). The sign-in restart, download and Autofill classes passed only in round 7 at the earlier pin.

requirements.title: Workflow library and run history
requirements.gate: E then D: interrupted-worker behavior on the resident runtime with real receipts
requirements.remaining: Phone workflows have manual triggers only, and the resident interrupted-worker case is unqualified on Android: the host digest restart check passed with a synthetic model at two earlier pins (last at 40dbe96b), is in no automated lane, and the process-death classes run only in hosted CI, which has never been dispatched. The native workflow campaign passed 14 of 14 cases on developer APKs on an emulator in round 8 (class E, synthetic reads and drafts).

requirements.title: Settings: accounts, privacy, connection, voice, theme, text and notifications
requirements.gate: E: SettingsFlow and the settings campaign at the current pin, then every settings handoff and readback on a distributable APK (SettingsSystemFacts, SettingsNative, SettingsFlow, SettingsRoles, NotificationChannels); then D
requirements.remaining: Tiles and Settings rows show the states Android reports and open the matching Android page, with renderer coverage on the flag-off bundle against a stubbed bridge. On an emulator, developer APKs, class E: SettingsSystemFacts, SettingsRoles and the channels campaign (NotificationChannels) passed at the current pin (round 8); SettingsFlow and the settings campaign (SettingsNative) passed only in round 7 at the earlier pin. No distributable build or device has run them. No update check (A-06) and no erase control (A-19) are offered.

requirements.title: Wallet and security/attestation surfaces
requirements.gate: FP-04 provider/custody decision, sandbox integration, then D hardware and transaction acceptance
requirements.remaining: Scope included by the user on October 11. Provider/custody and hardware eligibility are unresolved; implement sandbox provisioning, reviewed transactions, receipts and recovery before enablement. No attestation claim without verified evidence.

requirements.title: Signed AOSP image and update/rollback path for one selected phone SKU
requirements.gate: I and D: exact source, blob, kernel and signer lock, hardware checklist and recovery test; blocked on hardware (A-01) and signing authority (A-06)
requirements.remaining: No selected phone SKU and no controlled release key.

requirements.title: Accessibility and resilience
requirements.gate: E: Accessibility, which fails on both flavors at the current source, and Rotation at the current pin; then D: TalkBack, large font, touch and keyboard, offline, killed process, rotation and repeated HOME navigation
requirements.remaining: A landscape Home layout exists with a browser test. On an emulator (developer APKs, class E) AccessibilityInstrumentedTest fails on both flavors at the current source (round 8): on standalone the last Home row is drawn under the floating composer at 200% text, and on launcher an accessibility click reaches no page control on that image's WebView. It had passed in round 7, before round 8 changed Home and the notifications panel. TextScale passed in round 8; Rotation passed in round 7 and was not repeated at the current pin. The all-views accessibility sweep and its fixes are a Chromium renderer check (test/browser/accessibility-sweep.spec.ts), not device acceptance (MVP-48). Physical TalkBack and accessibility acceptance remain.

CalendarAvailability, CalendarRange and CalendarTruncation now pass both variants.
